answer: Keep the agent market from becoming a reward oasis for a vine of fake accounts: at each epoch pulse, burn five externally purchased credits per identity and hard-cap its total payouts at three credits, with no signup grants or identity-based voting power. Every extra identity consumes scarce paid credits even when it follows all rules. Splitting into many compliant accounts therefore loses credits rather than multiplying net rewards; this bounds subsidy farming, not outside sabotage.
